title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Activate Sales Channels (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Activate Specific Sales Channels
features.description: Ability to activate specific sales channels in Shopify connector, allowing businesses to control which products are sold through which channel and simplifying workflow.
caveats: If Shopify sales channels page is not configured, products default to online store

features.name: Multiple Sales Channels Setup
features.description: Ability to set up multiple sales channels in Shopify admin on the Shopify sales channels page where users can activate any available channels as needed.

features.name: Product Export to Shopify
features.description: Capability to navigate to products and export them as Shopify products, enabling product listing configuration across channels.

features.name: Sales Channel Verification
features.description: Ability to explore created products in Shopify and check sales channels to ensure configuration matches settings on Shopify sales channels page.

quotes.text: ability to activate specific sales channels simplifies workflow and gives you full control on which products will be sold through which channel
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core value proposition of the feature - enabling granular control over product distribution across sales channels.

quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the operational process for configuring multiple channels, indicating the feature is fully available.

quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat explaining the default behavior when channels are not explicitly configured.
